name: Phishing
description: Adversaries send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.

name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Adversaries send spearphishing emails with a malicious attachment.

name: Spearphishing Link
description: Adversaries send spearphishing emails with a malicious link.

name: User Execution
description: Adversary relies on user executing malicious content.

name: Malicious File
description: Adversary relies on a user opening a malicious file.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Adversaries abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.

name: Visual Basic
description: Adversaries abuse VBA/VBScript for execution.

name: JavaScript
description: Adversaries abuse JavaScript for execution.

name: Obfuscated Files or Information
description: Adversaries encrypt, encode, or otherwise obfuscate content.

name: Software Packing
description: Adversaries perform software packing to conceal their code.

name: Masquerading
description: Adversaries manipulate features to make files/processes appear legitimate.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Adversaries communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection.

name: Proxy
description: Adversaries use a connection proxy to direct network traffic.

name: Multi-hop Proxy
description: Adversaries chain together multiple proxies to disguise the source.

name: Resource Hijacking
description: Adversaries leverage resources of co-opted systems to complete resource-intensive tasks.

name: Browser Session Hijacking
description: Adversaries take advantage of web sessions to execute actions as the logged-in user.

name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
description: Adversaries position themselves between two or more parties to intercept data.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries obtain and abuse existing accounts' credentials.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Adversaries transfer tools or other files from an external system.

name: Process Injection
description: Adversaries inject code into processes to evade defenses and elevate privileges.

name: Native API
description: Adversaries interact directly with the native OS API.

name: Acquire Infrastructure
description: Adversaries buy, lease, or rent infrastructure for operations.

name: Stage Capabilities
description: Adversaries upload, install, or configure capabilities that can be used during targeting.

name: Phishing for Information
description: Adversaries send phishing messages to elicit sensitive information.

name: Web Service
description: Adversaries use web services to send commands to compromised systems.
